data.name: Ebrahim
data.gender_notes: Ebrahim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ebrahim is the Arabic form of Abraham, the prophet and messenger in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes leadership, wisdom, and spiritual guidance. The name Ebrahim carries the meaning “Father of Many” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ebrahim usually hope their child will grow to embody father of many and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ebrahim is considered a prophet and messenger in Islam, known for his unwavering faith and obedience to Allah's commands.
data.etymology: Ebrahim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of Many.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ebrahim total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إبراهيم
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر معناه أبو الجماجم أو الأب الغالب
in_arabic.long_meaning: إبراهيم هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، وهو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، ويعني الأب الغالب أو أبو الجماجم، ويرتبط هذا الاسم بالنبي إبراهيم عليه السلام، الذي يعتبره المسلمون والد النبي إسماعيل وإسحق، ويحظى هذا الاسم بمكانة عالية في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: ابراہیم
in_urdu.meaning: مذکر نام، معنی ابو الجماجم یا غالب اب
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابراہیم ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے ابو الجماجم یا غالب اب، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا بڑا مقام ہے، کیونکہ یہ نام النبی ابراہیم علیہ السلام سے منسلک ہے، جو کہ اسلام میں ایک اہم نبی مانے جاتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: इब्राहिम
in_hindi.meaning: पुंलिंग नाम, अर्थ पिता या श्रेष्ठ पिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: इब्राहिम एक पुंलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है, इसका अर्थ है पिता या श्रेष्ठ पिता, यह नाम कुरआन में उल्लेखित है और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसकी महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका है, क्योंकि यह नाम पैगंबर इब्राहिम से जुड़ा है, जो इस्लाम में एक महत्वपूर्ण पैगंबर माने जाते हैं

in_pashto.name: ابراهيم
in_pashto.meaning: د نارينو نوم، معنی يې د پلار غالب يا ابو الجماجم
in_pashto.long_meaning: ابراهيم د نارينو نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه يې اخستل دي، معنی يې د پلار غالب يا ابو الجماجم دی، دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې ياد شوی دی، او په اسلامي ميراث کې يې لوړه درجه ده، ځکه چې دا د پيغمبر ابراهيم عليه السلام نوم دی، چا چې په اسلام کې د پيغمبر په توګه ستره رول لري

in_english.name: Ebrahim
in_english.meaning: a masculine name meaning father of many or exalted father
in_english.long_meaning: Ebrahim is a masculine given name derived from the Arabic language, meaning 'father of many' or 'exalted father.' It is a significant name in Islam, associated with the Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham in English), a highly revered figure in the Islamic faith. The name has its roots in the Quran and has been used across various Muslim cultures. Etymologically, it stems from the Arabic root 'Abir,' which connotes the idea of being a father or a patriarch. The name symbolizes leadership, spiritual guidance, and paternal virtues.

data.cultural_impact: Ebrahim holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world due to its connection to the revered biblical prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) whose stories are integral to Jewish, Christian, and Islamic traditions. This name is deeply rooted in Islamic heritage and shares values encompassing unwavering faith, honoring covenants, and embodying hospitality. A name as sacred as Ebrahim creates a sense of belonging, community, and respect among fellow Muslims and communities worldwide.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, Ebrahim is believed to carry profound spiritual significance due to the faith and devotion displayed by the prophet Ibrahim in the Quran and Hadiths. As mentioned in the Quran, he was a model of submission and obedience, being willing to sacrifice his only son as an act of faith in Allah. On a deeper level, this name represents the ongoing spiritual journey of self-rule and dedication to faith, mirroring the devotion of the prophet, as each individual strives to live their lives in accordance with Allah's guidance and the teachings of Ibrahim.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Father of Many" symbolizes Ebrahim is the Arabic form of Abraham, the prophet and messenger in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes leadership, wisdom, and spiritual guidance.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ebrahim serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of father of many.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibrahim is the name of the patriarch in the Hebrew Bible and the Quran. The name Ebrahim carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibrahim, also known as Abraham in the Hebrew Bible, is a significant figure in monotheistic religions. He is considered the father of the prophets in Islam, and his story is recounted in both the Hebrew Bible and the Quran.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ebrahim remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
